page.overview:
Who is Magmanites?

Atom Eve Guardians of the Globe Damien Darkblood Demons Satan

Magmanites are subterranean, lava creatures that appear in Invincible. They are servants to Volcanikka and Doc Seismic.

Magmanites were first seen being commanded by Doc Seismic, emerging from underground during his attacks. They act as overwhelming enemies through numbers and raw force.

Later, they are shown to be seen with Volcanikka, showing that they are under her control.
